_doc: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Copy to store/costops-package-inventory.json (gitignored) and put the real packages there -- no concrete plan name, price, account or quota belongs in this tracked file. Consumed by src/costops/package-inventory.ts and the Phase 4 recommendation engine (src/costops/portfolio-recommendation.ts).

_fields.kind: held | external_market_reference -- external_market_reference is comparison-only; enabled_for_routing is FORCED false for it regardless of what this file says
_fields.price/quota_limit/overage_rate: a ProvenancedNumber: { value, currency, provenance, as_of, source_note }. value is null (never 0) when not published/not entered -- provenance and as_of travel WITH the number.
_fields.quota_shape: unlimited | session_and_weekly_pct | token_ceiling | seat_count | usage_metered | unknown
_fields.subscription_id: optional cross-reference to costops-subscriptions.json's entry id for a held package that also has a lifecycle fact there

overage_rate.source_note: per-token overage, read off pricing page

packages.name: Example Plan With No Confirmed Price

price.source_note: aggregator-derived, NOT vendor-confirmed -- see the market snapshot doc's own gate notes before treating this as fact
